purpose: Reconstruct the public inspiral (2,2) mode before NQC by dividing the pinned binary's pre-attachment output by its returned NQC factor, evaluated on returned high-rate dynamics. Compare its amplitude, amplitude slope, and gravitational-wave frequency with exact-hash native pre-NQC samples at fixed orbital frequency. Keep every sample at least 1 M before both the inferred match and output mode peak; this cannot reconstruct samples after ringdown attachment or prove centered matching parity.
